scientific_limitations: The uniform ranking is proved only for convex regular unit-circumradius polygon pairs in orthogonal two-planes. Approximate square-pentagon values are numerical. Possible unindexed earlier equivalent results remain a priority risk; no independent audit.
title: Universal two-level normal-cone angle inversion in orthogonal regular-polygon joins
